comment: The nethackrc names the hero with the NAME statement, which the recorder (scripts/record-session.mjs recordSegment()) does not read: it looks only for an OPTIONS name: value and passes "-u ''". sys/unix/unixmain.c process_options() (385-396) copies the empty argument over the configured name after initoptions(), so plnamesuffix() asks "Who are you?" and the game uses the typed name (js/unixmain.js parseNethackrcName(), process_options()).
